name: watcher_status
description: Get watcher service health, version, and uptime.

name: watcher_service
description: Manage the watcher system service. Actions: install, uninstall, start, stop, restart, status.

name: watcher_config
description: Query watcher running configuration. Optional JSONPath filter.

name: watcher_config_apply
description: Apply a config patch to the running watcher service.

replace.description: Replace the whole config instead of merging

name: watcher_search
description: Semantic search over indexed documents. Supports Qdrant filters. This is a direct tool: call it directly, never through tool_call.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

name: watcher_set_metadata
description: Set or update metadata on a document by file path or source reference.

name: watcher_validate_config
description: Validate a candidate config (or current config if omitted). Optionally test file paths against the config to preview rule matching and metadata output.

config.description: Partial config merged over the current one; omit to check it.

testPaths.description: Paths to run through the candidate config.

name: watcher_reindex
description: Trigger a reindex of the watched files. Without scope, re-applies inference rules (scope "rules"); the HTTP API's own default is "issues".

scope.description: Reindex scope: "issues" re-processes documents that failed; "rules" re-applies inference rules without re-embedding; "full" re-embeds everything; "path" reindexes the given files or directories (`path`) or source references (`source`); "prune" deletes points for files no longer in watch scope.

dryRun.description: Return the blast-area plan (counts by root) without running the reindex.

name: watcher_scan
description: Filter-only point query without vector search. Returns metadata for points matching a Qdrant filter. Use for structural queries: file enumeration, staleness checks, delta computation. Use watcher_search for semantic/similarity queries. This is a direct tool: call it directly, never through tool_call.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from previous response for pagination.

countOnly.description: If true, return { count } instead of points.

name: watcher_list_issues
description: Get runtime processing failures. Shows the documents (file path or source reference) that failed processing and why.

name: watcher_walk
description: Walk watched filesystem paths with glob intersection. Returns matching file paths from all configured watch roots, applying watch.ignored and gitignore filtering.

globs.description: Globs matched against the watched files.

name: watcher_get_vcs_status
description: Get version tracking health: enabled state, tracked roots, remote status, last activity

name: watcher_list_vcs_history
description: Query change history by path or glob with optional date range

glob.description: Glob inside a VCS-enabled watch root.

since.description: Only commits after this date (any date git log accepts).

until.description: Only commits before this date (any date git log accepts).

name: watcher_show_vcs_file
description: Retrieve file content at a specific version

name: watcher_diff_vcs
description: Show what changed between two versions, or between a version and current

glob.description: Glob inside a VCS-enabled watch root.

commitEnd.description: Version to diff to (default: the working tree).

name: watcher_revert_vcs
description: Undo changes by restoring files to a specific version

existingOnly.description: Restore only files that exist in the working tree.

name: watcher_exclude_vcs_path
description: Exclude a path from version history (VCS-only: it stays in search), or remove the exclusion. Adding untracks the files the pattern matches, ending their history. Without confirm: true, more than 100 files return { confirmRequired: true, untracked } and change nothing: check the count with the user, then repeat with confirm: true. A timeout does not cancel the exclusion: check the outcome with watcher_check_vcs_exclusion before retrying.

glob.description: One gitignore pattern, absolute (under a VCS root) or relative to `root`. It is written root-anchored (`/` + the root-relative pattern) to the root's `.git/info/exclude`. Brackets are a character class: escape them to name a file literally (`Report \[draft\].docx`). A newline, a leading `!` or `#`, braces, or a pattern matching the whole root is refused.

remove.description: Remove the pattern instead of adding it (from `.git/info/exclude`, else from the `.gitignore` a 0.20.0 exclude wrote). Files are not re-added; their next change is versioned again.

root.description: VCS root to write under (default: the root containing the glob); a glob outside it is refused.

confirm.description: Required (true) when adding the pattern would untrack more than 100 files.

name: watcher_check_vcs_exclusion
description: Check whether git ignores a path and why: the rule, the file holding it and its line

path.description: Path inside a VCS-enabled watch root.

name: watcher_list_facets
description: List the search facets: every field a rule schema gives a uiHint or enum, with its type, uiHint, rules and values (the declared enum, else values recorded per rule for dropdown, tags, select and multiselect; never per tenant). With rules, only those rules. Build Qdrant filters for watcher_search and watcher_scan from them.

rules.description: Comma-separated rule names (configured or registered at runtime): only fields those rules declare, with values recorded for their documents. Unknown names answer 400. Without it, every configured rule.

name: watcher_count_facets
description: Count documents per value of facet fields under an optional Qdrant filter (each document once; counts are approximate), or { min, max } for number, date and range fields. Each field needs a payload index (400 names the ones without); 503 while the system indexes build (retry later) or past the time budget (count fewer fields or narrow the filter). Use it for "how many per value" questions and for tenant-scoped value lists.

filter.description: Qdrant filter scoping the counts, as for search (e.g. a tenant condition).

rules.description: Rule names (configured or registered at runtime): only documents that matched at least one of them are counted, each once. Unknown names answer 400.

fields.description: Payload fields to count (1 to 20). Each needs a payload index: keyword, integer or bool for value counts; integer, float or datetime for a range.

limit.description: Most values per counted field, highest counts first (default 100, max 1000).

name: watcher_render
description: Render a document through the inference rules it matches: its rendered content, output format, matching rules and resulting metadata. Takes exactly one of a file path (the whole file is read) or a source reference (fetched through its callback).

name: watcher_match_config
description: Test file paths against the inference rules and watch scope without reading the files: per path, the matching rule names and whether the path is watched.

paths.description: File paths to test against the watch scope and rules.
